description: In front of you are a folded green cloth on the table and two small plastic place settings: a yellow cup on a yellow saucer with utensils, and a blue cup on a blue saucer with utensils. The left hand and right hand first work together to pull and unfold the green cloth into a flat mat, then the right hand repeatedly reaches to the yellow set to remove a spoon, knife, fork, cup, and plate and places them onto the mat; next, the right hand takes blue utensils and cup/plate pieces from the blue set and lays them on the mat as well, while the left hand stays nearby without touching objects.
